svg.title: A lattice-periodic cell pattern multiplied by a spatial Bloch phase
svg.desc: The atomic sites lie at integer x/a. A prescribed real periodic factor u_demo(x)=0.25+0.75 cos^8(pi x/a) repeats its peak at every site. Three constructed Bloch-form functions psi_k=exp(ikx)u_demo compare ka=0, pi/4 and pi. The blue real part is u_demo cos(kx); the gold imaginary part is u_demo sin(kx). Gray dashed curves mark plus and minus u_demo. Vertical guides mark atomic sites, not trajectories. Only the phase changes with k, so the squared modulus remains u_demo squared. No energy or common-potential eigenstate is assigned. The mobile view shows five sites; the desktop view shows seven.
svg.text: (a) Cell pattern: same peak at every site
(c) ka = π/4: a gradual phase change
(d) ka = π: alternating signs at sites
Atomic sites: integer x/a · Same cell factor for all k
